name: Druid
lore: Versatile shapeshifter of nature: tank heavy hits in Bear Form, bleed foes in Cat Form, or call down stars and mends in Caster Form.

resource.name: Forms & Combo
resource.tip: Shapeshift between Caster, Bear, Cat, and Moonkin forms. Cat attacks generate Combo Points for finishers.
resource.rules: Shift between Bear Form for heavy armor and thorns, Cat Form for combo builders and bleeds, and Caster Form for nature spells and healing touch.

forms.caster: Default form. Heals and Restoration spells.
forms.bear: Bear Form: Block, Thorns, taunt, Maul/Swipe/Bash.
forms.cat: Cat Form: Combo Points, bleeds, Stealth, Rip and Ferocious Bite.
forms.moonkin: Moonkin Form: Balance spells deal +3 damage.

archetypes.name: Balance
archetypes.text: Wrath, Moonfire and Starfire: ranged nature and arcane damage, bolstered by Moonkin Form.

archetypes.name: Feral Combat
archetypes.text: Bear for defense, cat for bleeds and Combo Point finishers.

archetypes.name: Restoration
archetypes.text: Heals over time, Swiftmend, Innervate and Rebirth: out-sustain the spire.

relics.name: Stormrage Cover
relics.text: While in Cat Form, gain 1 Combo Point at the start of each turn.

relics.name: Idol of Ferocity
relics.text: While in Bear Form, gain 2 Block each time you play a card.
